title: Dau Pha Thuong Khau Episode 17: The Elder Fled
audience: Fans of Chinese fantasy, wuxia/xianxia drama viewers, 18-35 demographic
tone: Confrontation, power reversal, elder humiliated, justice served, rising legend

concept.hook: Elder Hai Kun: 'He's just a废物 with a lucky pill!' He charged — Dou Huang level aura EXPLODING. Xiao Yan raised one finger. Blue-violet flame appeared. The elder stopped mid-charge.
concept.story_arc: Elder Hai Kun confronts Xiao Yan → Boasts of Dou Huang power → Charges with full aura → Xiao Yan raises one finger → Flame vs elder's aura → Elder realization and retreat → Xiao Yan's warning
concept.emotion: Boast → Charge → Shock → Recognition → Humiliation → Warning

shots.prompt: Wide shot — the sect courtyard. Elder Hai Kun faces Xiao Yan across the open ground. The elder's face is twisted with rage. 'You destroyed my assassins with a TRICK! Now face me properly!' Dou Huang (Fight Emperor) aura EXPLODES from him — so intense it cracks the courtyard stones. Camera: wide — elder's Dou Huang aura exploding, cracked courtyard stones, Xiao Yan standing still in the center. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide — elder's Dou Huang aura exploding, cracked courtyard stones, Xiao Yan standing in center, 6s
shots.narration: Dou Huang aura. The elder's full power. It cracked the stones beneath his feet. Xiao Yan stood in the center of that pressure — and smiled.
shots.sfx: Aura explosion, stone cracking, elder's rage roar, powerful wind, courtyard debris

shots.prompt: Close-up — Xiao Yan raises one finger. A single point of blue-violet flame appears on his fingertip. The elder charges. His Dou Huang aura should crush Xiao Yan effortlessly. But something makes him slow down. His eyes lock on that single flame. Camera: close-up — Xiao Yan's raised finger with single violet-blue flame point, elder charging then slowing, his eyes locking on flame. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — single violet-blue flame on finger, elder charging then slowing, recognition in his eyes, 6s
shots.narration: That flame. The elder's face changed. Because he recognized it. The Flame Emperor's fire — the fire that had killed Dou Sheng (Fight Saint) level masters three hundred years ago.
shots.sfx: Elder charging, footsteps slowing, his sharp inhale, flame crackling, fear entering voice

shots.prompt: Close-up — the elder STOPS. His Dou Huang aura flickers with fear. 'The Flame Emperor's fire?!' His voice cracks. Xiao Yan nods slightly. 'Your assassins were just the beginning.' The elder's face goes pale. Camera: close-up — elder stopping, Dou Huang aura flickering, pale face, recognition of danger, his voice cracking. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — elder stopping, aura flickering with fear, pale face, voice cracking, recognition of danger, 6s
shots.narration: The elder stopped. His Dou Huang power — meant nothing against the fire that had killed Dou Sheng masters three centuries ago.
shots.sfx: Aura flickering, elder's fearful voice crack, silence falling, wind stopping, Xiao Yan's calm breathing

shots.prompt: Medium shot — the elder FLEES. He turns and runs — Dou Huang fleeing from a Dou Wang. Disciples watch in disbelief. The elder disappears over the sect wall. Xiao Yan lowers his finger. Camera: medium — elder fleeing over sect wall, disciples watching in shock and disbelief, Xiao Yan lowering finger calmly. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Medium — elder fleeing over sect wall, disciples watching in shock, Xiao Yan lowering finger calmly, 6s
shots.narration: Dou Huang fled. From his own student. The elder ran over the wall like a thief — and no one stopped laughing for three days.
shots.sfx: Elder fleeing footsteps, disciples' shocked gasps turning to laughter, wall rustling, relief laugh, wind returning

shots.prompt: Wide shot — Xiao Yan addresses the gathered disciples. 'He killed my father. He'll answer for it.' His voice is ice. Then he turns and walks away, violet-blue flame trailing his footsteps. The disciples bow spontaneously as he passes. Camera: wide — Xiao Yan addressing disciples with his warning, bowing disciples, violet-blue flame trailing, emperor's walk. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide — Xiao Yan addressing disciples, bowing disciples as he passes, violet-blue flame trailing, 6s
shots.narration: He declared his intention. The elder who killed his father would answer for it. And with every step he took — the disciples bowed.
shots.sfx: His ice-cold declaration, disciples bowing, flame trailing footsteps, triumphant orchestral swell, wind carrying his words

audio.narration: Dou Huang aura. The elder's full power. It cracked the stones beneath his feet. Xiao Yan stood in the center of that pressure — and smiled. That flame. The elder's face changed. Because he recognized it. The Flame Emperor's fire — the fire that had killed Dou Sheng (Fight Saint) level masters three hundred years ago. The elder stopped. His Dou Huang power — meant nothing against the fire that had killed Dou Sheng masters three centuries ago. Dou Huang fled. From his own student. The elder ran over the wall like a thief — and no one stopped laughing for three days. He declared his intention. The elder who killed his father would answer for it. And with every step he took — the disciples bowed.
audio.bg_music: Epic confrontation Chinese orchestral, Dou Huang aura, flame recognition, elder fleeing, emperor's walk 100 BPM
